description: Haiagaru 1.6.0 pre-release: Edge archive search in board/category/thread toolbars, expanded ChMate 0.8.10.242 dev support, improved Hissi/Kyodemo ID and Wacchoi search, and a lifecycle guard for a rare viewer-back crash. Includes MEGA sync reliability fixes. Android MPP for ChMate 0.8.10.191 dev, 0.8.10.226 dev, 0.8.10.241, 0.8.10.242 dev, and 0.8.10.243 dev.
